testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.publish.DeploymentFailureRecoveryTests

testcase.name: manual rollback is idempotent - repeating it neither rebuilds nor duplicates history nor audit()
an unhealthy release is ROLLING_BACK before it is FAILED and never RUNNING - the previous release is back()
an address that cannot be reached is UNKNOWN, which is not success()
a manual rollback marks the newer release ROLLED_BACK, which is terminal and no longer restorable - roll forward means publishing again()
a crash in ROLLING_BACK is resumed - the previous release comes back, the deployment ends FAILED, it never rolls forward()
an address that answers 5xx after the switch is not RUNNING - the previous release is restored()
a crash in ROLLING_BACK of a first release ends with the site offline()
a transient render outage is retried a bounded number of times, then fails with the reason and the attempt count()
automatic rollback that cannot restore fails closed - pointer NULL, deployment FAILED, ROLLBACK_FAILED then ROLLBACK_OFFLINE, nothing served()
a first release that fails verification never serves anything - the site stays without a pointer()
a failed artifact store write fails the build with ARTIFACT_STORE_UNAVAILABLE and leaves the previous release serving()
a permanent render failure fails once with its reason, is not retried and publishes nothing()
a release whose artifact cannot be verified is never switched in - the previous release keeps serving and the pointer is never touched()
unpublish moves the pointer through the scope, bumps its version and leaves every deployment status alone()
publishing again with the same Idempotency-Key creates no second deployment and no second build()
a transient failure that goes away is retried to success with exactly one artifact and one active release()
the recovery sweeper picks up a deployment that stopped in ROLLING_BACK()
an active pointer at a failed deployment is reported offline, never online()
without a public host to probe the release is verified by its pointer and artifact and the detail says the probe did not run()
manual rollback to a release whose artifact is gone is refused, recorded, and changes nothing()
